cards.gloss_cn: 圣诞节(12月25日的西方节日)
cards.ex_en: We put up a tree every Christmas.
cards.ex_cn: 每年圣诞节我们都会摆一棵圣诞树。

cards.gloss_cn: 中国的;中国瓷的(这里指中国瓷花瓶)
cards.ex_en: She bought a beautiful Chinese vase at the shop.
cards.ex_cn: 她在店里买了一只漂亮的中国瓷花瓶。

cards.gloss_en: the first day of the week, after Saturday
cards.ex_en: On Sunday we like to sleep late.
cards.ex_cn: 星期天我们喜欢睡懒觉。

cards.gloss_cn: 洪普迪-邓普迪(故事里虚构的人物,滚下楼梯却当上国王娶了公主)
cards.gloss_en: invented fairy-tale figure who fell downstairs yet became king
cards.ex_en: The children begged for the tale of Humpy-Dumpy again.
cards.ex_cn: 孩子们又央求讲洪普迪-邓普迪的故事。

cards.gloss_cn: 洪普迪-邓普迪(故事里虚构的人物,滚下楼梯却当上国王娶了公主)
cards.gloss_en: invented fairy-tale figure who fell downstairs yet became king
cards.ex_en: In the story, Humpy-Dumpy married the princess at last.
cards.ex_cn: 在故事里,洪普迪-邓普迪最后娶了公主。

cards.gloss_cn: 伊威迪-阿威迪(故事里虚构的名字,孩子们想听的另一个故事)
cards.gloss_en: invented nonsense name of another tale the children wanted
cards.ex_en: Some kids shouted for the story of Ivedy-Avedy instead.
cards.ex_cn: 有些孩子却嚷着要听伊威迪-阿威迪的故事。

cards.gloss_cn: 伊威迪-阿威迪(故事里虚构的名字,孩子们想听的另一个故事)
cards.gloss_en: invented nonsense name of another tale the children wanted
cards.ex_en: Nobody knew how the tale of Ivedy-Avedy ended.
cards.ex_cn: 谁也不知道伊威迪-阿威迪的故事结局如何。
